rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dlc_addresses AS (
  -- get street address records for DLCs named 'History' (case-insensitive)
  SELECT
    mdh.`DLC_KEY` AS DLC_KEY,
    mdh.`DLC_NAME` AS DLC_NAME,
    fba.`FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY` AS FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY,
    fba.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    fba.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fba.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
    fba.`STREET_NUMBER` AS STREET_NUMBER,
    fba.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX` AS STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
    fba.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` AS PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.`STREET_NAME` AS STREET_NAME,
    fba.`STREET_SUFFIX` AS STREET_SUFFIX,
    fba.`POST_DIRECTIONAL` AS POST_DIRECTIONAL,
    fba.`CITY` AS CITY,
    fba.`STATE` AS STATE,
    fba.`POSTAL_CODE` AS POSTAL_CODE,
    fba.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS ADDRESS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM `master_dept_hierarchy` mdh
  JOIN `fclt_building_address` fba
    ON fba.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` = mdh.`DLC_KEY`
       OR fba.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = mdh.`DLC_CODE`
  WHERE LOWER(mdh.`DLC_NAME`) = LOWER('History')
    AND fba.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
),
buildings_basic AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`
  FROM `buildings`
),
combined AS (
  -- prefer joining by explicit building key, else by building number
  SELECT
    da.DLC_KEY,
    da.DLC_NAME,
    COALESCE(bb.BUILDING_KEY, da.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(
      bb.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
      NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
        NULLIF(da.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
        NULLIF(da.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, ''),
        NULLIF(da.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
        NULLIF(da.STREET_NAME, ''),
        NULLIF(da.STREET_SUFFIX, '')
      )), ''),
      NULL
    ) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    da.CITY,
    da.STATE,
    da.POSTAL_CODE,
    da.ADDRESS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM dlc_addresses da
  LEFT JOIN buildings_basic bb
    ON (bb.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND bb.BUILDING_KEY = da.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
       OR (bb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND bb.BUILDING_NUMBER = da.BUILDING_NUMBER)
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  POSTAL_CODE
FROM combined
-- if multiple address records exist, prefer the most recent address by warehouse load date when present
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN ADDRESS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ADDRESS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  ccs.MEET_PLACE AS LOCATION,
  at.TERM_START_DATE AS TERM_START_DATE,
  isp.PERSON_NAME AS SUPERVISOR_NAME
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccs
JOIN academic_terms at
  ON (ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE)
    OR (ccs.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND ccs.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE)
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_person isp
  ON isp.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
    AND (
         -- try to match by responsible faculty name if available
         (ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND isp.PERSON_NAME = ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
         -- or match by MIT id if available (RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID in catalog vs MIT_ID in people table)
         OR (ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND isp.PERSON_NAME = ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)
       )
WHERE
  -- narrow to IAP / independent activity offerings
  (
    ccs.IS_OFFERED_IAP IN ('Y','1')
    OR ccs.TERM_DURATION = 'IAP'
    OR ccs.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    OR ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') ASC

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subjects_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID, '') AS SUBJECT_ID,
    NULLIF(cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_TITLE, '') AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    NULLIF(cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_CODE, '') AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    NULLIF(cis_course_catalog.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '') AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  FROM cis_course_catalog
)
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  m.TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE,
  m.ISBN AS ISBN,
  SUM(
    -- prefer NEW_SHELF_PRICE numeric; fallback to 0 if NULL or non-numeric text
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(CONVERT(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, SIGNED), 0) , 
      COALESCE(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)
    )
  ) AS TOTAL_NEW_MATERIAL_COST
FROM course_subjects_canonical c
JOIN tip_detail d
  ON c.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN tip_material m
  ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_material_status s
  ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
WHERE (
    LOWER(COALESCE(s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, '')) LIKE '%new%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, '')) LIKE '%new%'
  )
  AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE <> ''
  AND m.TITLE IS NOT NULL AND m.TITLE <> ''
  AND m.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND m.ISBN <> ''
GROUP BY
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  m.TITLE,
  m.ISBN
ORDER BY
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC,
  m.TITLE ASC

rows.question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.

SELECT
  COALESCE(f.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name_long,
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.DATE_BUILT),''), '%m/%d/%Y')) AS built_year,
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS num_employees
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN fac_building f
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = f.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE
  -- only consider rows where DATE_BUILT parses to a year and is before 1950-01-01
  STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.DATE_BUILT),''), '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL
  AND STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.DATE_BUILT),''), '%m/%d/%Y') < DATE('1950-01-01')
  -- require more than 100 employees according to buildings.BUILDING_COUNTER
  AND b.BUILDING_COUNTER > 100
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_COUNTER DESC

rows.question: For each IAP category and academic year, list the category name, academic year, total fee collected, total number of IAP subjects, and the minimum and maximum enrollment.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  d.`SO_CLUSTER_TYPE` AS category_name,
  d.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS academic_year,
  SUM(IFNULL(i.total_fee,0)) AS total_fee_collected,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS total_iap_subjects,
  MIN(IFNULL(s.min_enrollment,0)) AS min_enrollment,
  MAX(IFNULL(s.max_enrollment,0)) AS max_enrollment
FROM (
  SELECT
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `SO_CLUSTER_TYPE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `IS_OFFERED_IAP`,
    `TERM_DURATION`
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
  WHERE `IS_OFFERED_IAP` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`IS_OFFERED_IAP`) <> ''
    AND `SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`SECTION_ID`) <> ''
) d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    SUM(IFNULL(`FEE`,0)) AS total_fee
  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`, `SUBJECT_ID`
) i
  ON i.`SUBJECT_ID` = d.`SUBJECT_ID`
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    MIN(IFNULL(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`,0)) AS min_enrollment,
    MAX(IFNULL(`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`,0)) AS max_enrollment
  FROM `subject_summary`
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`, `SUBJECT_ID`
) s
  ON s.`SUBJECT_ID` = d.`SUBJECT_ID`
WHERE TRIM(UPPER(d.`IS_OFFERED_IAP`)) = 'Y'
GROUP BY d.`SO_CLUSTER_TYPE`, d.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`
ORDER BY d.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` ASC, d.`SO_CLUSTER_TYPE` ASC

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  ssp.`SPONSOR_NAME` AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(isd.`ATTENDANCE`, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  -- MIN/MAX should ignore NULLs; aggregate functions do that by default
  MIN(isd.`FEE`) AS MIN_FEE,
  MAX(isd.`FEE`) AS MAX_FEE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN iss.`HAS_SESSION_INFO` = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN iss.`HAS_SESSION_INFO` = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO
FROM `iap_subject_sponsor` ssp
JOIN `iap_subject_detail` isd
  ON ssp.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY` = isd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_session` iss
  ON isd.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` = iss.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`
WHERE ssp.`SPONSOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  AND ssp.`SPONSOR_NAME` <> ''
  -- restrict to IAP sessions: either TERM_CODE indicates IAP or TERM_DURATION = 'IAP'
  AND (
        (isd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND isd.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%IAP%')
        OR (isd.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL AND isd.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` IS NOT NULL AND isd.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%IAP%')
        OR (isd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND isd.`TERM_CODE` = 'IAP')
        OR (isd.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL AND isd.`TERM_CODE` = 'IAP')
        OR (isd.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` IS NOT NULL AND (isd.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%IAP%' OR isd.`TERM_CODE` = 'IAP'))
        OR (isd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND isd.`TERM_CODE` <> '' AND isd.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%IAP%')
      )
GROUP BY ssp.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`, ssp.`SPONSOR_NAME`
ORDER BY ssp.`SPONSOR_NAME` ASC

    dc.SUBJECT_ID,
    dc.SUBJECT_CODE,
    dc.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS GRADUATE_LEVEL
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dc
),
-- derive school mapping for each department using fclt_organization (map by HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD when available)
dept_school_map AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS school_code,
    COALESCE(f.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS school_name,
    f.DLC_KEY
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM sis_subjects_rowlevel
  ) s
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization f
    ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD
),
-- per-school aggregate of subjects and departments and min/max subject number
subject_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.school_code,
    m.school_name,
    m.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ID,
                            CONCAT(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_CODE,''),'|',COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'')))) AS sis_subject_count,
    -- numeric min/max when possible
    MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'')) REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
          THEN CAST(TRIM(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS DECIMAL(38,10))
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS min_course_number_numeric,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'')) REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
          THEN CAST(TRIM(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS DECIMAL(38,10))
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS max_course_number_numeric,
    MIN(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '')) AS min_course_number_text,
    MAX(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '')) AS max_course_number_text,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count
  FROM dept_school_map m
  JOIN sis_subjects_rowlevel ss
    ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY m.school_code, m.school_name, m.DLC_KEY

-- choose the most common graduate_level value per school (ties broken deterministically)
gradlevel_choice AS (
  SELECT
    school_code,
    GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS school_code,
      s.GRADUATE_LEVEL,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE)
                         ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.GRADUATE_LEVEL ASC) AS rn
    FROM sis_subjects_rowlevel s
    LEFT JOIN fclt_organization f
      ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD
    GROUP BY COALESCE(f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE), s.GRADUATE_LEVEL
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ss.school_code AS school_code,
  ss.school_name AS school_name,
  ss.dlc_key AS dlc_key,
  gc.graduate_level AS graduate_level,
  ss.sis_subject_count AS sis_subject_count,
  -- prefer numeric min/max when any numeric values exist, otherwise use text min/max
  CASE
    WHEN ss.min_course_number_numeric IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(ss.min_course_number_numeric AS CHAR)
    WHEN ss.min_course_number_text <> '' THEN ss.min_course_number_text
    ELSE NULL
  END AS min_course_number,
  CASE
    WHEN ss.max_course_number_numeric IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(ss.max_course_number_numeric AS CHAR)
    WHEN ss.max_course_number_text <> '' THEN ss.max_course_number_text
    ELSE NULL
  END AS max_course_number,
  ss.department_count AS department_count
FROM subject_stats ss
LEFT JOIN gradlevel_choice gc
  ON gc.school_code = ss.school_code

WITH buildings_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    `buildings`.`BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    CASE
      WHEN `buildings`.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND `buildings`.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> '' THEN `buildings`.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
      ELSE `buildings`.`BUILDING_KEY`
    END AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    `buildings`.`BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM `buildings`
  WHERE `buildings`.`BUILDING_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `buildings`.`BUILDING_NAME` <> ''
),
-- normalize rooms/spaces: try fclt_rooms and space_detail as sources for ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE and FLOOR
rooms_by_building_component AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_ID,
    -- try to use BUILDING_NUMBER from fclt_rooms (BUILDING_ROOM appears to hold the public building number in this schema)
    CASE
      WHEN f.BUILDING_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND f.BUILDING_ROOM <> '' THEN f.BUILDING_ROOM
      ELSE b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    END AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    -- prefer explicit ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE from space_detail when available, otherwise use f.AREA
    COALESCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, f.AREA, 0) AS ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COALESCE(f.FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY, sf.FLOOR) AS FLOOR_NUMBER
  FROM fclt_rooms f
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
    ON sd.BUILDING_ROOM = f.BUILDING_ROOM
  LEFT JOIN space_floor sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
),
-- facility organizations linked to building via fclt_organization (carry keys)
fac_orgs_by_building_component AS (
  SELECT
    fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS ORG_KEY,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
    fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL AS has_org,
    -- determine building identifiers by joining to fclt_rooms_hist/fclt_rooms is not necessary; use fclt_organization -> fclt_org_dlc_key is not building-linked in schema
    -- we attempt to link via fclt_rooms which has FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_ROOM AS BUILDING_NUMBER
  FROM fclt_organization fo
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  -- keep distinct org rows
  GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_ID, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.BUILDING_ROOM
),
-- assignments / supervisors / supervisees from zpm_rooms_load joined to warehouse_users where possible
staff_assignments_by_building_component AS (
  SELECT
    z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS ASSIGNMENT_ID,
    -- link to fclt_rooms to get building identifiers
    CASE WHEN fr.BUILDING_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.BUILDING_ROOM <> '' THEN fr.BUILDING_ROOM ELSE b.BUILDING_NUMBER END AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS SUPERVISOR_ID,
    wu.MIT_ID AS SUPERVISEE_ID
  FROM zpm_rooms_load z
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = fr.BUILDING_ROOM
      AND (z.FLOOR <=> fr.FLOOR)
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_users wu
    ON z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = wu.UNIT_ID
  WHERE z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  -- building_component_id: BUILDING_NUMBER when available, otherwise BUILDING_KEY
  COALESCE(bc.BUILDING_NUMBER, bc.BUILDING_KEY) AS building_component_id,
  bc.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  -- total_room_square_footage: sum of ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE from rooms_by_building_component
  COALESCE(SUM(r.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0) AS total_room_square_footage,
  -- total_number_of_floors: distinct floor count among rooms/spaces for the component
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(r.FLOOR_NUMBER, '')), 0) AS total_number_of_floors,
  -- total_number_of_rooms: distinct room ids
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.ROOM_ID), 0) AS total_number_of_rooms,
  -- total_number_of_facility_organizations: distinct facility organizations linked via fclt_organization -> fclt_rooms
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID), 0) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  -- total_number_of_supervisors: distinct supervisors from assignments linked to the component
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT sa.SUPERVISOR_ID), 0) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  -- total_number_of_supervisees: distinct supervisees from assignments linked to the component
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT sa.SUPERVISEE_ID), 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees
FROM buildings_canonical bc
LEFT JOIN rooms_by_building_component r
  ON (bc.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND r.BUILDING_NUMBER = bc.BUILDING_NUMBER)
   OR ((bc.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') AND r.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY)
LEFT JOIN fac_orgs_by_building_component fo
  ON (bc.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND fo.BUILDING_NUMBER = bc.BUILDING_NUMBER)
   OR ((bc.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') AND fo.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY)
LEFT JOIN staff_assignments_by_building_component sa
  ON (bc.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND sa.BUILDING_NUMBER = bc.BUILDING_NUMBER)
   OR ((bc.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') AND sa.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY)
GROUP BY COALESCE(bc.BUILDING_NUMBER, bc.BUILDING_KEY), bc.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY building_component_id

FROM buildings bc

  ON bc.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

    fo_inner.DLC_KEY,

    FROM space_supervisor_usage

  GROUP BY fo_inner.DLC_KEY

WITH course_subject_rows AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    c.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    c.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR c.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
tip_offering_agg AS (
  -- aggregate TIP subject offerings from tip_subject_offered, preserving keys
  SELECT
    tsi.TERM_CODE,
    tsi.SUBJECT_ID,
    tsi.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    MAX(tsi.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL) AS IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL,
    MAX(tsi.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MAX(tsi.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(tsi.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM tip_subject_offered tsi
  GROUP BY tsi.TERM_CODE, tsi.SUBJECT_ID, tsi.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
-- identify TIP offerings by explicit TIP flag or textual match
tip_offerings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM tip_offering_agg t
  WHERE
    (t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL) = 'Y')
    OR (t.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(t.SUBJECT_TITLE) LIKE '%TIP%')
    OR (t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) LIKE '%TIP%')
    OR (t.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(t.SUBJECT_ID) LIKE '%TIP%')
),
-- rental prices per department from tip_detail -> tip_material
dept_rental_prices AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(td.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(td.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE
  FROM tip_offerings t
  JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
   AND td.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE IS NOT NULL
),
-- Sum enrollments per department (only numeric, null treated as zero already in aggregation)
dept_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM tip_offerings t
  GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
-- Count distinct TIP subjects per department (subject-level distinct)
dept_tip_subject_count AS (
  SELECT
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS tip_subject_count
  FROM tip_offerings t
  GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT
  csr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COALESCE(dts.tip_subject_count, 0) AS tip_subject_count,
  COALESCE(de.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students,
  -- min/max rental across available numeric prices for the department; NULL if none
  MIN(dr.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
  MAX(dr.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM course_subject_rows csr
-- link departments from course/catalog to TIP offer dept code
LEFT JOIN dept_tip_subject_count dts
  ON dts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = csr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment de
  ON de.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = csr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_rental_prices dr
  ON dr.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = csr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE
  -- ensure the department exists in the course/catalog (we already selected from that table),
  -- but filter out rows without a department name (require department_name present)
  csr.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  csr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY
  csr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH current_term AS (
  -- determine the current term from either table
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
  FROM academic_terms at
  WHERE at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'

  UNION

  SELECT
    NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    atp.TERM_CODE,
    atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM
  FROM academic_term_parameter atp
  WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
),
courses_current_term AS (
  -- course rows for the current term; use EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE or TERM_CODE as present in course_catalog_subject_offered
  SELECT
    c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(c.TERM_CODE, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    c.HGN_CODE,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    c.SECTION_ID,
    -- derive course type flags from the presence of section-level boolean-ish columns if present;
    -- fall back to IS_LECTURE_SECTION / IS_LAB_SECTION / IS_RECITATION_SECTION if available in this table
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_LECTURE_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_lecture,
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_LAB_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_lab,
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_RECITATION_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_recitation,
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_DESIGN_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_design
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  JOIN current_term ct
    ON COALESCE(c.TERM_CODE, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) = ct.TERM_CODE
  WHERE (c.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL)
    AND (c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL)
),
faculty_email AS (
  -- prefer employee_directory for email resolution (MIT_ID), fall back to drupal_employee_directory if needed
  SELECT
    e.MIT_ID,
    e.EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM warehouse_users e
  WHERE e.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND e.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  WHERE d.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND d.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ct.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ct.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  cc.HGN_CODE AS HGN_CODE,
  -- TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_COURSE_TYPES: count of distinct course-type flags present for the course/section group.
  -- We compute per-group distinct types by summing distinct boolean flags across all sections for that HGN_CODE.
  (  GREATEST(MAX(cc.is_lecture),0)
   + GREATEST(MAX(cc.is_lab),0)
   + GREATEST(MAX(cc.is_recitation),0)
   + GREATEST(MAX(cc.is_design),0)
  ) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_COURSE_TYPES,
  AVG(cc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVERAGE_NUMBER_OF_UNITS,
  cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  f.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL
FROM current_term ct
JOIN courses_current_term cc
  ON ct.TERM_CODE = cc.TERM_CODE
JOIN faculty_email f
  ON cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = f.MIT_ID
-- ensure we only include rows for the current term marker
WHERE ct.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ct.ACADEMIC_YEAR),
  ct.TERM_CODE,
  cc.HGN_CODE,
  cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  f.EMAIL_ADDRESS
ORDER BY
  cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  cc.HGN_CODE

  co.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,

SELECT

  scb.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS CATEGORY,
  sss.SESSION_TITLE,
  sis.MEET_START_TIME AS SESSION_START_TIME,

  `tip_material`.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` AS `MATERIAL_ID`,

  -- join path: tip_material has no subject, so we LEFT JOIN to tip_subject_offered -> cis_course_catalog on SUBJECT_ID to get subject columns when available.

  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,

  `tip_material_status`.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS `MATERIAL_STATUS`,
  `tip_subject_offered`.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS `SCHOOL_ID`,

  `tip_material`.`USED_SHELF_PRICE` AS `USED_SHELF_PRICE`,

  -- If stored as NULL, return NULL. If stored as numeric already, pass through.
  -- Use CAST to ensure numeric type; if conversion fails produce NULL via NULLIF + CAST wrapped in CASE.
  CASE
    WHEN `tip_material`.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(`tip_material`.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` AS SIGNED)
  END AS `NEW_SHELF_PRICE_NUM`,
  CASE
    WHEN `tip_material`.`USED_SHELF_PRICE` IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(`tip_material`.`USED_SHELF_PRICE` AS SIGNED)
  END AS `USED_SHELF_PRICE_NUM`

WITH course_catalog_fall_offerings AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SECTION_ID,
    TERM_CODE,
    IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE (TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' OR IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR (FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) <> ''))
),
-- normalize instructor rows: prefer RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID when present, otherwise use each name listed in FALL_INSTRUCTORS (comma-separated)
exploded_instructors AS (
  SELECT
    cco.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cco.SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cco.TERM_CODE,
    -- instructor identifier columns: mit id when available, else NULL
    NULLIF(TRIM(cco.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID), '') AS instr_mit_id,
    -- instructor name: if RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME present use that, else expand FALL_INSTRUCTORS
    NULLIF(TRIM(cco.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME), '') AS instr_name_from_responsible,
    cco.FALL_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM course_catalog_fall_offerings cco
),
-- split FALL_INSTRUCTORS by comma into rows when responsible id/name not provided
fall_instructor_names AS (
  SELECT
    ei.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ei.SUBJECT_ID,
    ei.SUBJECT_CODE,
    ei.TERM_CODE,
    ei.instr_mit_id,
    -- when RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME exists use that as the instructor name; otherwise use each value from FALL_INSTRUCTORS
    CASE
      WHEN ei.instr_name_from_responsible IS NOT NULL THEN ei.instr_name_from_responsible
      ELSE TRIM(fi.instructor_name)
    END AS instructor_name
  FROM exploded_instructors ei
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- split comma-separated FALL_INSTRUCTORS; handle NULL/empty safely
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_ID,
      TERM_CODE,
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1) AS instructor_name,
      FALL_INSTRUCTORS
    FROM (
      SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, FALL_INSTRUCTORS
      FROM course_catalog_fall_offerings
      WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) <> ''
    ) t
    JOIN (
      -- numbers 1..10 (adjust if more instructors might be listed)
      SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
      UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    ) numbers
    ON numbers.n <= 1 + LENGTH(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', ''))
  ) fi
  ON ei.SUBJECT_ID = fi.SUBJECT_ID AND ei.TERM_CODE = fi.TERM_CODE
),
-- now we have rows with instructor_name and optional instr_mit_id; remove blanks/nulls
clean_instructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    TERM_CODE,
    instr_mit_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(instructor_name), '') AS instructor_name
  FROM fall_instructor_names
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(instructor_name), '') IS NOT NULL
),
-- lookup emails by MIT_ID or by matching full name in drupal_employee_directory
email_by_mit AS (
  SELECT MIT_ID, EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
  WHERE EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(EMAIL_ADDRESS) <> ''
),
email_by_name AS (
  SELECT FULL_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
  WHERE EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(EMAIL_ADDRESS) <> ''
),
-- determine each instructor's email: prefer MIT_ID match, else name match
instructors_with_email AS (
  SELECT
    ci.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ci.SUBJECT_ID,
    ci.SUBJECT_CODE,
    ci.TERM_CODE,
    ci.instr_mit_id,
    ci.instructor_name,
    COALESCE(ebm.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ebn.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS instructor_email
  FROM clean_instructors ci
  LEFT JOIN email_by_mit ebm
    ON ci.instr_mit_id IS NOT NULL AND ci.instr_mit_id = ebm.MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN email_by_name ebn
    ON ebm.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL AND ci.instructor_name = ebn.FULL_NAME
  WHERE COALESCE(ebm.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ebn.EMAIL_ADDRESS) IS NOT NULL
),
-- compute per-instructor distinct fall subject count (count distinct SUBJECT_TITLE or SUBJECT_CODE per requirements)

  SELECT
    COALESCE(instr_mit_id, instructor_name) AS instr_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE)) AS instructor_fall_subject_count
  FROM instructors_with_email
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
  GROUP BY COALESCE(instr_mit_id, instructor_name)
)

SELECT
  iwe.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  iwe.instructor_name AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  iwe.instructor_email AS INSTRUCTOR_EMAIL,
  COALESCE(ifsc.instructor_fall_subject_count, 0) AS INSTRUCTOR_FALL_SUBJECT_COUNT
FROM instructors_with_email iwe
LEFT JOIN instructor_fall_subject_counts ifsc
  ON ifsc.instr_key = COALESCE(iwe.instr_mit_id, iwe.instructor_name)
WHERE iwe.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
  AND iwe.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(iwe.SUBJECT_TITLE) <> ''
  AND iwe.instructor_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(iwe.instructor_name) <> ''
ORDER BY

  iwe.instructor_name ASC

  COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  ON (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND edn.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
    OR (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND edn.FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)

     OR (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND member_lists.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)

rows.question: For email lists subscribed by either support staff or faculty, list its name, the number of subscribers that are support staff, the number of subscribers that are faculty, as well as its active status.

WITH employees_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(ded.MIT_ID) AS MIT_ID,
    -- normalize common variants but preserve canonical literals 'Support Staff' and 'Faculty' exactly when present
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(ded.EMPLOYEE_TYPE) IS NULL OR TRIM(ded.EMPLOYEE_TYPE) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(ded.EMPLOYEE_TYPE)) IN ('FACULTY','PROFESSOR','INSTRUCTOR') THEN 'Faculty'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(ded.EMPLOYEE_TYPE)) IN ('SUPPORT STAFF','SUPPORT','STAFF','ADMIN','ADMINISTRATIVE') THEN 'Support Staff'
      ELSE TRIM(ded.EMPLOYEE_TYPE)
    END AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE,
    TRIM(ded.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    TRIM(ded.FULL_NAME) AS FULL_NAME
  FROM drupal_employee_directory AS ded
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS support_staff_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS faculty_count,
  m.IS_ACTIVE AS active_status
FROM moira_list AS m
JOIN moira_list_detail AS d
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN employees_normalized AS e
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  m.IS_ACTIVE
HAVING
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) > 0
  OR COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) > 0

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH bio_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    -- prefer explicit enrollment columns if present; schema has SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER and NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS in different tables.
    -- subject_offered has SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER and NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS; use NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS if present, else SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0), so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
    AND COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
),
cluster_enroll_stats AS (
  SELECT
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    SUM(ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS CLUSTER_TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
    AVG(ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS CLUSTER_AVG_ENROLLMENT
  FROM bio_subjects
  GROUP BY CLUSTER_TYPE
),
course_leveled AS (
  SELECT
    bs.*,
    -- derive course level from COURSE_NUMBER when possible: take leading numeric part and map to a simple level like 100/200/300/400/500+.
    CASE
      WHEN bs.COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
        LPAD(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(REGEXP_SUBSTR(bs.COURSE_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'), 1, 1), '00'), 3, '0')
      WHEN bs.COURSE_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]{3,}' THEN SUBSTRING(REGEXP_SUBSTR(bs.COURSE_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'),1,3)
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS COURSE_LEVEL
  FROM bio_subjects bs
),
tip_agg AS (
  -- aggregate TIP materials per term+subject+material
  SELECT
    td.TERM_CODE,
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT,0)) AS MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE
  FROM tip_detail td
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE
),
tip_course_stats AS (
  -- per course (term+subject) TIP aggregates
  SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS UNIQUE_TIP_MATERIALS,
    -- average prices: exclude NULLs; keep NULL if no non-null prices
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN NULL
         ELSE AVG(t.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) END AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.USED_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN NULL
         ELSE AVG(t.USED_SHELF_PRICE) END AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    SUM(t.MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT) AS TOTAL_TIP_RECORD_COUNT
  FROM tip_agg t
  GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID
),
lib_reserve_agg AS (
  SELECT
    lrd.TERM_CODE,
    lrd.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,'')) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc ON lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY lrd.TERM_CODE, lrd.SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS COURSE_TITLE,
  COALESCE(c.CLUSTER_TYPE, '(none)') AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
  -- total enrollments for this course (subject+term); spec asked "total enrollments" per group — we interpret as sum per grouping below,
  -- but keep the course-level enrollment here to allow aggregation if consumer needs per-group sums; following spec, we aggregate by cluster+course_level below.
  COALESCE(c.ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0) AS COURSE_ENROLLMENT,
  COALESCE(ces.CLUSTER_AVG_ENROLLMENT,0) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER,
  c.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(tcs.UNIQUE_TIP_MATERIALS,0) AS UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS_COUNT,
  tcs.AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE,
  tcs.AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE AS AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE,
  COALESCE(tcs.TOTAL_TIP_RECORD_COUNT,0) AS TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORDS,
  COALESCE(lra.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES,0) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES_COUNT,
  COALESCE(lra.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS,0) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS_COUNT
FROM course_leveled c
LEFT JOIN cluster_enroll_stats ces
  ON ( (c.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL AND ces.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL) OR (c.CLUSTER_TYPE = ces.CLUSTER_TYPE) )
LEFT JOIN tip_course_stats tcs
  ON tcs.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE AND tcs.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN lib_reserve_agg lra
  ON lra.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE AND lra.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY c.CLUSTER_TYPE, c.COURSE_LEVEL, c.SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subject_offering_rows AS (
  SELECT
    c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    c.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- course_catalog_subject_offered has no OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME; use DEPARTMENT_NAME as SCHOOL_NAME fallback
    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    c.`TOTAL_UNITS` AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.`IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR` AS IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    c.`IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM` AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    c.`IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM` AS IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM,
    c.`FALL_INSTRUCTORS` AS FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    c.`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` AS SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,
    c.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    c.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` c
  LEFT JOIN `academic_terms_all` at
    ON at.`TERM_CODE` = c.`TERM_CODE`
),
subject_level_and_units AS (
  SELECT
    csso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    csso.TOTAL_UNITS AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    csso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    csso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    -- derive a coarse course level from leading digits of SUBJECT_NUMBER
    CASE
      WHEN csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
        CASE
          WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_SUBSTR(csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+')) >= 3
            THEN CONCAT(LEFT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+'),1),'00')
          WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_SUBSTR(csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+')) = 2
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+')
          ELSE REGEXP_SUBSTR(csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+')
        END
      ELSE csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER
    END AS COURSE_LEVEL
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered csso
  GROUP BY csso.SUBJECT_ID, csso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, csso.TOTAL_UNITS, csso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, csso.SUBJECT_TITLE
),
academic_term_codes AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR
  FROM academic_terms_all at
)
SELECT
  sld.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  csr.SCHOOL_NAME,
  csr.SUBJECT_ID,
  csr.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  sld.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  sld.TOTAL_UNITS,
  t.offered_term,
  atc.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(fall_counts.fall_instructor_count, 0) AS fall_instructor_count,
  COALESCE(spring_counts.spring_instructor_count, 0) AS spring_instructor_count
FROM subject_level_and_units sld
JOIN (
  -- pick one row per subject to get school and academic year; use GROUP_CONCAT trick and SUBSTRING_INDEX to simulate ANY_VALUE
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(SCHOOL_NAME SEPARATOR '|||'), '|||', 1) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ACADEMIC_YEAR SEPARATOR '|||'), '|||', 1) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(SUBJECT_TITLE SEPARATOR '|||'), '|||', 1) AS SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM course_subject_offering_rows
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
) csr ON csr.SUBJECT_ID = sld.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    'Fall' AS offered_term,
    CONCAT(ACADEMIC_YEAR, 'FA') AS TERM_CODE
  FROM course_subject_offering_rows
  WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    AND SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    'Spring' AS offered_term,
    CONCAT(ACADEMIC_YEAR, 'SP') AS TERM_CODE
  FROM course_subject_offering_rows
  WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
    AND SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
) t ON t.SUBJECT_ID = sld.SUBJECT_ID AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = csr.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN academic_term_codes atc ON atc.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT instr) AS fall_instructor_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_ID,
      ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)) AS instr
    FROM course_subject_offering_rows
    JOIN (
      SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
      UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    ) numbers
      ON FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
      AND CHAR_LENGTH(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')) >= numbers.n-1
    WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
  ) parsed
  WHERE instr <> ''
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR
) fall_counts ON fall_counts.SUBJECT_ID = sld.SUBJECT_ID AND fall_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = csr.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT instr) AS spring_instructor_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_ID,
      ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)) AS instr
    FROM course_subject_offering_rows
    JOIN (
      SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
      UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    ) numbers
      ON SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
      AND CHAR_LENGTH(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')) >= numbers.n-1
    WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
  ) parsed
  WHERE instr <> ''
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR
) spring_counts ON spring_counts.SUBJECT_ID = sld.SUBJECT_ID AND spring_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = csr.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY sld.DEPARTMENT_NAME, csr.SUBJECT_ID, t.offered_term

WITH catalog_items_with_material_status_and_department AS (

    ccsf.SUBJECT_ID,
    ccsf.SUBJECT_CODE,

  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccsf
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrsmd
    ON ccsf.TERM_CODE = lrsmd.TERM_CODE
    AND ccsf.SUBJECT_ID = lrsmd.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS lrc
    ON lrsmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status AS lms
    ON lrsmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE
    -- require a material status and a department (per task); treat empty strings as distinct values
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS IS NOT NULL
    AND (ccsf.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR ccsf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = '')
    -- require a catalog record date and only include on/after 2000-01-01
    AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL
    AND STR_TO_DATE(lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE('2000-01-01')

-- prepare mapping from catalog items to subject/section keys (distinct catalog item -> subject/section)
catalog_item_subject_section AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    SECTION_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID
  FROM catalog_items_with_material_status_and_department
  WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL

    ON ci.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = cis.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

    ON ( (cis.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND cis.SECTION_ID = so.SECTION_ID)

FROM base_detail

WITH course_department_catalog_links AS (
  SELECT
    cso.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,

    cso.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,

course_enrollment_counts AS (
  -- get enrollment per section from subject_offered (prefer integer fields)
  SELECT
    so.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS ENROLLMENT
  FROM `subject_offered` so
  WHERE so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
course_catalog_item_links AS (
  -- links from section (term + subject + section_id) to catalog items via reserve detail -> catalog
  SELECT
    cso.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    cso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    cso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS CATALOG_KEY
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` cso
  JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrm
    ON lrm.`TERM_CODE` = cso.`TERM_CODE`
    AND lrm.`SUBJECT_ID` = cso.`SUBJECT_ID`
  JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
    ON lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  WHERE cso.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL

  -- combine department, enrollment and catalog item counts per section
  SELECT
    d.SECTION_ID,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(ec.ENROLLMENT, 0) AS ENROLLMENT,
    -- count catalog links (count each catalog link separately). Use COUNT(*) on joins from reserve detail.
    COALESCE(ci.catalog_item_count, 0) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT
  FROM course_department_catalog_links d

    GROUP BY SECTION_ID

FROM per_section ps

UNION ALL

rows.question: Group buildings by campus sectors. For each group, list the campus sector, name of the building, city and state where the building is located, total number of floors, total assignable area, total number of rooms, total number of organizations, ownership type, and a rank column indicating the order (1-indexed) of this row within each sector based on the descending order of assignable area. Include subtotals for each sector and a grand total across all sectors. The subtotal and grand total only need to computed over the total number of floors and assignable area.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE,
    fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    -- total floors from buildings table (or assumed TOTAL_FLOORS); use BUILDING_COUNTER per DDL
    b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
    -- assignable area from fac_building (per instructions assume ASSIGNABLE_AREA exists)
    fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    -- number of rooms from fac_building (or assumed NUM_OF_ROOMS)
    fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
    -- ownership type from fac_building (or assumed OWNERSHIP_TYPE)
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
       OR (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME)
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE (b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL OR b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL)
    AND (fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR IS NOT NULL)  -- exclude rows where campus sector cannot be determined
),
-- details with rank, exclude null or non-numeric ASSIGNABLE_AREA for ranking/sums
details AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    COALESCE(TOTAL_FLOORS,0) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
    -- treat ASSIGNABLE_AREA as integer for sorting/aggregation
    CASE WHEN ASSIGNABLE_AREA REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    TOTAL_ROOMS,
    NULL AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM buildings_base
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA DESC, BUILDING_NAME) AS SECTOR_RANK
  FROM details d
  WHERE ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL
),
-- subtotals per sector (aggregate only TOTAL_FLOORS and ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
sector_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    CONCAT('Subtotal - ', CAMPUS_SECTOR) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    SUM(TOTAL_FLOORS) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
    SUM(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    NULL AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
    NULL AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS SECTOR_RANK,
    1 AS sort_group, -- to order subtotal after details
    MIN(CAMPUS_SECTOR) AS grp -- helper for ordering
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY CAMPUS_SECTOR
),
-- grand total across all sectors
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    'Grand Total' AS BUILDING_NAME,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    SUM(TOTAL_FLOORS) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
    SUM(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    NULL AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
    NULL AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS SECTOR_RANK,
    2 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS grp
  FROM ranked
)
-- final select: detail rows, then subtotal per sector, then grand total
SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  TOTAL_FLOORS,
  ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  TOTAL_ROOMS,
  TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  SECTOR_RANK
FROM (
  -- detail rows: mark sort_group 0 to come before subtotals
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    TOTAL_FLOORS,
    ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    TOTAL_ROOMS,
    TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SECTOR_RANK,
    0 AS sort_group,
    CAMPUS_SECTOR AS grp,
    -- ordering key for details: ASSIGNABLE_AREA desc, BUILDING_NAME
    ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS ord_assign_area,
    BUILDING_NAME AS ord_name
  FROM ranked

  UNION ALL

  -- subtotals
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    TOTAL_FLOORS,
    ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    TOTAL_ROOMS,
    TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SECTOR_RANK,
    sort_group,
    grp,
    NULL,
    NULL
  FROM sector_subtotals

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    TOTAL_FLOORS,
    ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    TOTAL_ROOMS,
    TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    SECTOR_RANK,
    sort_group,
    grp,
    NULL,
    NULL
  FROM grand_total
) t
ORDER BY
  -- group by sector for ordering: details (0), then subtotal (1), then grand total (2 at end)
  COALESCE(grp, CAMPUS_SECTOR),
  sort_group,
  -- within details sort by assignable area desc then building name
  CASE WHEN sort_group = 0 THEN ord_assign_area END DESC,
  CASE WHEN sort_group = 0 THEN ord_name END,
  -- ensure grand total comes last
  sort_group

        AND b.BUILDING_NAME NOT LIKE '%Unit%'

    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL

  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,
    COALESCE(fr.AREA, 0) AS AREA,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    ba.POSTAL_CODE AS ZIP_CODE,
    ba.CITY
  FROM buildings_base b
  JOIN space_detail sd
    ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  -- join to fclt_rooms using BUILDING_ROOM and building key to associate room rows
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
    AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address ba
    ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- floor-level aggregates for DP OF FACILITIES (treat null area as zero via COALESCE above)
floor_level_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS FLOOR_AREA_SUM,
    -- average area per floor = total area for that floor (since aggregate is per floor); keep for requested column
    SUM(r.AREA) AS AVG_AREA_PER_FLOOR_RAW,
    MAX(r.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
    MAX(r.ZIP_CODE) AS ZIP_CODE,
    MAX(r.CITY) AS CITY
  FROM rooms_by_floor_raw r
  WHERE r.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'

  JOIN buildings_base b USING (BUILDING_KEY)
)

SELECT
  CAST(f.BUILDING_KEY AS CHAR) AS BUILDING_KEY,
  CAST(f.FLOOR_KEY AS CHAR) AS FLOOR_KEY,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(f.ROOM_COUNT,0)),0) AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(f.FLOOR_AREA_SUM,0)),0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  -- for floor row, average area per floor equals floor area (one floor) rounded/formatted
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(f.FLOOR_AREA_SUM,0)),0) AS AVERAGE_AREA_PER_FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  f.ACCESS_LEVEL AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  f.ZIP_CODE AS ZIP_CODE,

UNION ALL

-- subtotals per building: FLOOR_KEY = 'SUBTOTAL', no ZIP/CITY

  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(f.FLOOR_AREA_SUM,0))),0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  FORMAT(
    ROUND(

    ),0

  NULL AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  NULL AS ZIP_CODE,
  NULL AS CITY

  BUILDING_NAME,
  -- put SUBTOTAL after floors for each building

    list_key,

  FROM moira_members
  GROUP BY list_key

  -- which lists each student is a member of
  SELECT

         OR LOWER(CONCAT(s.FIRST_NAME, ' ', s.LAST_NAME)) = LOWER(sm.member_text)

rows.question: For each department, list its name, number of unique courses offered, the number of unique reserved materials, and the number of unique instructors associated with those courses, sorted by the number of unique courses offered in descending order.

WITH course_catalog_course_identity AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS COURSE_OFFERING_ID,
    -- canonical course id: prefer SUBJECT_ID, else SUBJECT_CODE:COURSE_NUMBER when both present, else NULL
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID, '') <> '' THEN so.SUBJECT_ID
      WHEN COALESCE(sc.SUBJECT_CODE, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(so.COURSE_NUMBER, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE, ':', so.COURSE_NUMBER)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS canonical_course_id,
    -- canonical instructor id: prefer MIT_ID then name
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, '') <> '' THEN so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
      WHEN COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, '') <> '' THEN so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
      ELSE NULL
    END AS canonical_instructor_id,
    -- canonical reserved material id: prefer library_reserve_matrl_detail.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY then TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, '') <> '' THEN lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
      WHEN COALESCE(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, '') <> '' THEN td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
      ELSE NULL
    END AS canonical_reserved_material_id,
    -- department identifiers
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    -- carry term/subject for traceability
    so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    sc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER
  FROM subject_offered so
  LEFT JOIN sis_subject_code sc
    ON sc.COURSE_NUMBER = so.COURSE_NUMBER
       -- also try to match by subject id/code when available
       AND (COALESCE(sc.SUBJECT_CODE,'') = COALESCE(so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '') OR COALESCE(sc.SUBJECT_CODE,'') = COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID,''))
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lr
    ON lr.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND lr.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND td.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- collapse duplicates so each department-course-material-instructor combination is one row
department_course_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cc.canonical_course_id,
    cc.canonical_reserved_material_id,
    cc.canonical_instructor_id
  FROM course_catalog_course_identity cc
  -- remove rows without any course identity
  WHERE COALESCE(cc.canonical_course_id, '') <> ''
  GROUP BY
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cc.canonical_course_id,
    cc.canonical_reserved_material_id,
    cc.canonical_instructor_id
)
SELECT
  -- use DEPARTMENT_NAME from catalog; null/empty names will be grouped as NULL (excluded later if no courses)
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_course_id) AS unique_course_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(canonical_reserved_material_id, '')) AS unique_reserved_material_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(canonical_instructor_id, '')) AS unique_instructor_count
FROM department_course_rollup
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_course_id) > 0
ORDER BY unique_course_count DESC

    -- fee (can be NULL)
    isd.FEE AS FEE,
    -- carry through some grain keys for joinability
    dcc.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dcc
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail isd
    ON isd.TERM_CODE = dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_person isp
    ON isp.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_category isc
    ON isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

    ON ded.MIT_ID = dcc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
  WHERE dcc.IS_OFFERED_IAP IS NOT NULL

-- prefer actual person key, then MIT_ID, then responsible faculty MIT_ID, then responsible faculty name

  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    MIT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    PERSON_ROLE,
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    FEE,
    SECTION_ID,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY, ''),
      NULLIF(MIT_ID, ''),
      NULLIF(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ''),
      NULLIF(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, '')
    ) AS PERSON_IDENTIFIER
  FROM iap_person_role_fee_rows
)
SELECT
  PERSON_ROLE AS ROLE,
  IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS IAP_CATEGORY,
  -- count distinct people per role+category using the derived identifier
  COUNT(DISTINCT PERSON_IDENTIFIER) AS ROLE_COUNT,
  -- average fee excluding NULLs (AVG in MySQL ignores NULLs)
  AVG(FEE) AS AVG_FEE
FROM iap_person_identifier
WHERE PERSON_ROLE IS NOT NULL
  AND PERSON_ROLE <> ''
  AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME <> ''
  -- ensure we only count rows where we have at least one person identifier to count;
  -- if PERSON_IDENTIFIER is NULL then there is no identifiable person on that row, so exclude
  AND PERSON_IDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  PERSON_ROLE,

  ROLE_COUNT DESC

rows.question: For each school, list the school name, total number of courses that appear in SIS subject code catalog, and the total number of degree-granting courses that appear in SIS subject code catalog.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_course_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
    NULLIF(`course_catalog_subject_offered`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    -- The schema provided does not include IS_DEGREE_GRANTING on sis_subject_code or course_catalog_subject_offered.
    -- The original query used IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR as IS_DEGREE_GRANTING; that is not appropriate.
    -- Since IS_DEGREE_GRANTING does not exist in these tables, treat as non-degree-granting (NULL).
    NULL AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`,
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`
  FROM
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`
)
SELECT
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (
    CASE
      WHEN `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND `SUBJECT_ID` <> '' THEN `SUBJECT_ID`
      ELSE CONCAT_WS('|', `SUBJECT_CODE`, `SUBJECT_NUMBER`)
    END
  )) AS `TOTAL_COURSES_IN_SIS`,
  -- No IS_DEGREE_GRANTING column in the chosen table, so count is 0 per instructions.
  0 AS `TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING_COURSES_IN_SIS`
FROM `sis_course_row_level`
WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `DEPARTMENT_NAME` <> ''
GROUP BY `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
ORDER BY `SCHOOL_NAME` ASC

rows.question: For each department, list the department name, department phone number, number of students, and the length of the longest student full name in that department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH departments_directory_norm AS (
SELECT
  TRIM(NULLIF(drupal_employee_directory.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, '')) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
  TRIM(NULLIF(drupal_employee_directory.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, '')) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
  TRIM(NULLIF(drupal_employee_directory.OFFICE_PHONE, '')) AS OFFICE_PHONE
FROM drupal_employee_directory
WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(drupal_employee_directory.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, '')) <> ''
),
students_current_with_department AS (
SELECT
  d.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
  d.FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME,
  d.MIDDLE_NAME AS MIDDLE_NAME,
  d.LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME,
  -- canonical FULL_NAME: prefer stored FULL_NAME; if null/empty, build from parts (FIRST MIDDLE LAST)
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FULL_NAME, ''), NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN d.FULL_NAME
    ELSE TRIM(
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FIRST_NAME, ''), ''),
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FIRST_NAME, ''), '') <> '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MIDDLE_NAME, ''), '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', d.MIDDLE_NAME)
             WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FIRST_NAME, ''), '') <> '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MIDDLE_NAME, ''), '') = '' THEN ''
             WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FIRST_NAME, ''), '') = '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MIDDLE_NAME, ''), '') <> '' THEN d.MIDDLE_NAME
             ELSE '' END,
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FIRST_NAME, ''), '') <> '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MIDDLE_NAME, ''), '') <> '') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(d.LAST_NAME, ''), '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', d.LAST_NAME)
             WHEN (COALESCE(NULLIF(d.FIRST_NAME, ''), '') = '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MIDDLE_NAME, ''), '') = '') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.LAST_NAME, ''), '')
             ELSE '' END
      )
    )
  END AS FULL_NAME,
  -- department / org unit id indicating current association: use HR_ORG_UNIT_ID from drupal_employee_directory if present,
  -- otherwise NULL (do not substitute from other tables)
  d.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
FROM drupal_employee_directory d
WHERE d.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
students_count_and_name_length_by_dept AS (
SELECT
  d.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
  d.OFFICE_PHONE AS OFFICE_PHONE,
  COUNT(s.MIT_ID) AS student_count,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(
        COALESCE(s.FULL_NAME,
                 CONCAT_WS(' ', s.FIRST_NAME, s.MIDDLE_NAME, s.LAST_NAME))
      )) AS max_full_name_length
FROM drupal_employee_directory d
LEFT JOIN students_current_with_department s
  ON s.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = d.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
GROUP BY
  d.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
  d.OFFICE_PHONE
)
SELECT
  d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS department_name,
  d.OFFICE_PHONE AS department_phone,
  COALESCE(s.student_count, 0) AS student_count,
  s.max_full_name_length AS max_full_name_length
FROM departments_directory_norm d
LEFT JOIN students_count_and_name_length_by_dept s
  ON d.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = s.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
ORDER BY d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
